tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: Skill-Space is a curated collection of AI agent skills designed for Claude Code. Each skill is a self-contained directory under skills/ containing a SKILL.md definition, _meta.json metadata, and optional references/ with supporting documentation. The project serves as both a registry and a modular knowledge base, with skills spanning analytical frameworks, business operations, content creation, and practical tools.

tour.title: Charge Thinking — Analytical Framework
tour.description: The most architecturally sophisticated skill in the project, Charge Thinking combines bottom-line logic, the Charge thinking system, and CEO Plan Review into a seven-step composite framework. It covers systems thinking (causal chains, reinforcing loops, balancing loops), strategic thinking (endgame prediction, capability gaps), probability thinking, and counter-intuitive insights. This skill explicitly depends on gstack-plan-ceo-review for its final CEO-level review step.

tour.title: Charge Thinking Reference Materials
tour.description: Two foundational reference documents underpin the Charge Thinking framework. Charge思维体系.md documents the Charge thinking methodology covering induction, deduction, systematic thinking, and first-principles reasoning. 底层逻辑.md covers foundational logical principles, right-vs-wrong logic, compound interest thinking, and probability thinking. Together they provide the philosophical depth behind the skill's analytical approach.

tour.title: CEO Plan Review — Decision Framework
tour.description: The gstack-plan-ceo-review skill provides CEO/founder-mode plan review with four scope modes (EXPANSION, SELECTIVE, HOLD, REDUCTION) and 18 cognitive patterns. It covers system audits, nuclear scope challenges, and 11 review sections from architecture to deployment. This skill is a dependency of Charge Thinking and forms the final review step in its analysis framework.

tour.title: One Person Company Plus — Business Operations Hub
tour.description: The most comprehensive skill by content volume (372-line SKILL.md), OPC replaces an entire team of 5-10 people across five modules: content creation, business operations, product/R&D, customer service, and personal efficiency. Each module has defined trigger keywords and output formats. The skill achieved a perfect 5.0/5.0 TRACE evaluation score after targeted improvements.

tour.title: OPC Reference Documents
tour.description: Four reference documents support the OPC skill with deeper guidance. The system-prompt.md defines the full AI behavior framework. examples.md provides high-quality output demonstrations across all modules. anti-patterns.md catalogs common mistakes with before/after comparisons. faq-deep.md covers edge cases across security, privacy, and domain-specific scenarios.

tour.title: OPC Trace Evaluation Report
tour.description: The trace-report.html documents the OPC skill's quality evaluation journey from an original score of 4.7/5.0 to a perfect 5.0/5.0 after fixes. Five dimensions were assessed: Trust, Reliability, Adaptability, Convention, and Effectiveness. The report serves as a quality benchmark and demonstrates the iterative improvement process for skill development.

tour.title: One Person MCN — Content Creation Engine
tour.description: The largest single file in the project at 1124 lines, this skill replaces an entire MCN (Multi-Channel Network) agency team with 10 AI modules spanning topic planning, title optimization, content writing, SEO, video directing, cover design, community management, data analysis, business quoting, and publishing scheduling. It targets Chinese social media platforms including Xiaohongshu, Douyin, WeChat Official Accounts, and Bilibili.

tour.title: Tour Planner — Practical Travel Tool
tour.description: A focused, minimal skill (100 lines) that plans self-driving travel routes through a four-step workflow: parsing locations, querying driving times, generating Baidu Maps links, and formatting itineraries. Unlike the larger analytical or business skills, this is a single-purpose practical tool — demonstrating the range of skill sizes and purposes in the collection.

tour.title: Skill Infrastructure & Metadata
tour.description: The project's infrastructure layer consists of _meta.json files defining version, owner, and publication data for each skill, plus the .skills_store_lock.json registry tracking installation records. The .understandignore configures the knowledge graph analysis tool. These configuration files form the scaffolding that makes the skill collection self-documenting and machine-readable.
